name: select_box_search
title: Select Box Search
summary: Turns a native <select> into a searchable dropdown, single or multiple choice.
description: Progressive enhancement of a native <select>: the select stays in the form (value, change events, reset and URL state keep working, and without JavaScript the native select is shown) and select_box_search.js draws a button with the current choice and a panel with an optional search input and the option list. Enhanced: every select with the data-select-box-search attribute, printed by select_box_search::attrs($def). Options of $def: multiple (true = several choices at once, adds the multiple attribute, no empty option; shown as the joined labels and a count), search ("auto" default: the search input appears from search_min options, 8 by default; true = always; false = never), search_min, placeholder (text when nothing is chosen, --select-- or empty gives the ui text "all"). select_box_search::placeholder_option($def) prints the empty option for single selects. Keyboard: Enter / Space / arrows open, typing filters (diacritics ignored), arrows move, Enter picks, Esc closes, Backspace in an empty search removes the last choice. Texts: ui keys select_search_placeholder and select_no_matches. The component can also be placed on its own: { id, name, label, options (list of values, value => label map or list of { value, label }), selected (value or list), multiple, search, search_min, placeholder }. JS: window.selectBoxSearch.init(root), refresh(root), values(select). Used by filters_toolbar, filters_sort, filters_post_projects, hobby_pc_video_games_filters and search; the filters choose multiple per item in data_collection_listing_toolbar.json ("multiple": true), matching any of the chosen values.
